verdict.rationale: Navan documents an OAuth 2.0 API covering retrieval and update across the expense surface: card transactions, manual expenses, payroll, repayments, disputes, custom fields, receipts and webhooks. It also ships an official MCP server, but that server is described as a natural-language query layer for spend, policy and card data rather than a full action surface. Large parts of the UI have no documented API equivalent, especially travel booking, changes and cancellations, policy and approval workflow configuration, rewards, and issuing reimbursements. Missing for 10: API coverage of travel booking, changes and cancellations; policy and approval workflow management; card issuance and management actions; rewards; any documented statement of UI/API parity; independent corroboration.
